rationale: The aim is local improvement of prescribing with rapid learning, not a generalisable effect estimate. PDSA cycles with a weekly run chart fit the group's volume (about 90 systemic antimicrobial prescriptions a week), let the team revise the prompt wording and the guide between cycles, and use run chart rules to separate a real shift from noise. The retrieved evidence supports the prompt (c1) and feedback (c2) as change ideas and the drug-class measure (c3). Reporting follows SQUIRE 2.0.
alternatives: Stepped introduction across the four clinics with a formal comparison (refused: four clinics give no usable comparison and the aim is local)
Monthly feedback only without the prompt (kept as a fallback if the prompt is unworkable)
Comparing two annual totals before and after (refused: cannot separate change from season)
whyNotMoreComplex: A controlled or cluster design would need many more practices to estimate an effect the group does not need to generalise; the run chart answers whether these clinics improved and keeps the change package adaptable.

decision.statement: Run the stewardship change package in PDSA cycles across the four clinics from October 2026 to January 2027, measuring the weekly HPCIA share from the report builder on a run chart with amoxicillin-clavulanate share and 7-day re-consultation as balancing measures.
decision.question: Should the group run a QI project to reduce HPCIA prescribing with a prompt, a guide, free culture and monthly feedback?

criteria.text: A prescribing prompt and monthly feedback have each been followed by lower HPCIA use in comparable practices.
The outcome can be measured weekly from practice software without reading notes.
A national or regional stewardship campaign is running in the same months and would make local change impossible to read.

gates.requirement: Clinical governance classification of the project as quality improvement
gates.evidence: Record CGC-2026-031 dated 2026-09-08, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Partners' approval of a monthly feedback slot in each clinic's team meeting
gates.evidence: Partners' minute PM-2026-09-04 for October 2026 to January 2027, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Monthly feedback only without the prompt
Prompt only in the two clinics with the highest HPCIA share
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c3, each from a retrieved record, and on the investigator's governance and partners' records for the two gates.

summary: QI with PDSA cycles and weekly run charts recommended; the decision rests on three ledger claims from retrieved records and both gates are met on investigator-supplied records.
